description: asb-mods shared hook definitions. Every action here is either a self-contained shell one-liner or a script packaged in shared-core/hooks/bin, so the schema resolves on any machine: {{STATE_DIR}} is the installer state directory (~/.config/asb-mods), {{HOME}} the target home. lib/hooks.js resolves both at registration time.

placeholders.{{STATE_DIR}}: installer state directory (<config>/asb-mods) — packaged hook scripts are deployed here by lib/deploy.js
placeholders.{{CORE}}: shared-core source directory inside the installed package

session_style_reminder.action: printf '%s\n' 'asb-mods: reply style is terse and telegraphic; code, paths, numbers and warnings stay complete.'

retired.generate-adapters.sh: Shell generator removed: it had no pi case, read schema.events while the schema exposed schema.hooks, and its non-pi branches only wrote discovery reports. lib/hooks.js registers all three tools for real.
retired.plugin-cache hooks (ponytail, obsidian-c: Removed — they pointed at version-pinned plugin caches under ~/.claude/plugins on one machine, which is exactly the custom tooling phase 3 removes, so registering them guaranteed dangling commands.
